primary_title: Mucin 16 is a functional selectin ligand on pancreatic cancer cells
decision_basis: The reviews cite primary blot-rolling, flow-adhesion, and depletion studies showing sialofucosylated MUC16 is a functional E-selectin ligand on metastatic pancreatic cancer cells.
limitations_preserved: Preserve sialofucosylated MUC16 glycoform, metastatic pancreatic-cancer model, flow/shear context, and residual-ligand caveat; no MUC16 intracellular relay or SCI inference.
